structured_output.what_is_happening: Beff Jezos (@beffjezos) posted that something "is going to be called Kardashev Research". The canonical coin was launched on UsePaid with creator fees going to @beffjezos: mint 5wW9...7hUnp, about $1.67M market cap. This token (R1oF...) copies the canonical coin's description word for word, including the UsePaid link to the OTHER mint. Its pool was created directly on PumpSwap about 12 minutes ago and was never on a bonding curve. The deploy platform is unknown, LP is 100% unlocked, and the pool holds about $165k of liquidity against a market cap of about $108k. At least 9 other same-name clones exist, several already dead. One of them (Gff9) did $3.1M of hourly volume.
